mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO content_review (target_type, target_id, author_id, review_round, action, source, operator_id, reason, reason_code, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{authorId}, #{reviewRound}, #{action}, #{source}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{reasonCode}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT IGNORE INTO review_task (target_type, target_id, review_round, author_id, source, claim_state, entered_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reviewRound}, #{authorId}, #{source}, 'PENDING', #{enteredAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE review_task SET claim_by = #{claimBy}, claim_state = 'CLAIMED', claim_seq = claim_seq + 1, lease_expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND claim_state = 'PENDING'
mapper.sql: SET claim_state = 'PENDING', claim_by = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, escalated = IF(recycle_count + 1 >= 3, 1, escalated), recycle_count = recycle_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update:
UPDATE review_task
WHERE claim_state = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_expire_at < NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review_task WHERE escalated = 1 AND claim_state = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO content_report (target_type, target_id, author_id, reporter_id, reason, content_snapshot, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{authorId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{contentSnapshot}, 'PENDING', #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE content_report SET status = 'PROCESSED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handled_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE content_report SET status = 'IGNORED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handled_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, author_id, reporter_id, reason, content_snapshot, status, handler_id, handled_at, create_time, update_time FROM content_report WHERE id = #{reportId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_credit_detail WHERE user_id = #{authorId} AND reason_type = 'REPORT_CONFIRMED' AND ref_id IN (SELECT id FROM content_report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId})
mapper.sql: SELECT 'POST' AS target_type, rt.id AS task_id, rt.target_id, rt.review_round, rt.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.content) AS content, NULL AS reward, p.images, p.state AS status, p.create_time, rt.entered_at FROM review_task rt JOIN post p ON p.post_id = rt.target_id LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON u.user_id = rt.author_id WHERE rt.claim_state = 'PENDING' AND rt.target_type = 'POST' AND p.state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS target_type, rt.id AS task_id, rt.target_id, rt.review_round, rt.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, c.content AS content, NULL AS reward, NULL AS images, c.state AS status, c.create_time, rt.entered_at FROM review_task rt JOIN post_comment c ON c.comment_id = rt.target_id LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON u.user_id = rt.author_id WHERE rt.claim_state = 'PENDING' AND rt.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS target_type, rt.id AS task_id, rt.target_id, rt.review_round, rt.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.description) AS content, p.price AS reward, p.images, p.state AS status, p.create_time, rt.entered_at FROM review_task rt JOIN product p ON p.product_id = rt.target_id LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON u.user_id = rt.author_id WHERE rt.claim_state = 'PENDING' AND rt.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND p.state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

SELECT 'ERRAND' AS target_type, rt.id AS task_id, rt.target_id, rt.review_round, rt.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, e.description AS content, e.reward, e.images, e.state AS status, e.create_time, rt.entered_at FROM review_task rt JOIN errand_order e ON e.errand_order_id = rt.target_id LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON u.user_id = rt.author_id WHERE rt.claim_state = 'PENDING' AND rt.target_type = 'ERRAND' AND e.state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

ORDER BY entered_at ASC, task_id ASC
ORDER BY entered_at ASC, task_id ASC
ORDER BY entered_at ASC, task_id ASC
ORDER BY entered_at ASC, task_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING'
AND target_type = #{targetType}
SELECT target_type AS targetType, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING' GROUP BY target_type

SELECT COUNT(1) AS pendingCnt, COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, entered_at, NOW())), 0) AS avgWaitSeconds, COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, entered_at, NOW())), 0) AS oldestWaitSeconds FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING'

choose.when: SELECT 'POST' AS target_type, p.post_id AS target_id, p.review_round AS review_round, p.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.content) AS content, NULL AS reward, p.images, p.state, p.create_time FROM post p LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS target_type, c.comment_id AS target_id, 1 AS review_round, c.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, c.content AS content, NULL AS reward, c.state AS status, c.create_time FROM post_comment c LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS target_type, p.product_id AS target_id, p.review_round AS review_round, p.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.description) AS content, p.price AS reward, p.images, p.state AS status, p.create_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.product_id = #{targetId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'ERRAND' AS target_type, e.errand_order_id AS target_id, 1 AS review_round, e.publisher_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, e.description AS content, e.reward, e.images, e.state AS status, e.create_time FROM errand_order e LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON e.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE e.errand_order_id = #{targetId}

mapper.select: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, review_round, author_id, source, claim_state, claim_by, claim_seq, lease_expire_at, recycle_count, escalated, entered_at, decided_at, create_time, update_time FROM review_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'POST' AS target_type, p.post_id AS target_id, p.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.content) AS content, p.images, NULL AS reward, p.state AS status, NULL AS context_post_id, NULL AS context_post_title, NULL AS context_parent_id, NULL AS context_parent_content FROM post p LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS target_type, c.comment_id AS target_id, c.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.content AS content, c.images, NULL AS reward, c.state AS status, c.post_id AS context_post_id, p.title AS context_post_title,
CASE WHEN c.parent_id <> '0' THEN c.parent_id END AS context_parent_id, pc.content AS context_parent_content FROM post_comment c LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN post_comment pc ON pc.comment_id = c.parent_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS target_type, p.product_id AS target_id, p.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.description) AS content, p.images, p.price AS reward, p.state AS status, NULL AS context_post_id, NULL AS context_post_title, NULL AS context_parent_id, NULL AS context_parent_content FROM product p LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.product_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'ERRAND' AS target_type, e.errand_order_id AS target_id, e.publisher_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, e.description AS content, e.images, e.reward, e.state AS status, NULL AS context_post_id, NULL AS context_post_title, NULL AS context_parent_id, NULL AS context_parent_content FROM errand_order e LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON e.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE e.errand_order_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT reason FROM content_review WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND action = 'REJECT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT word FROM sensitive_word WHERE enabled = 1
SELECT id, word, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM sensitive_word ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sensitive_word
